title: Verkenningen inzake de inspraak bij de verstedelijkingsnota 1976
authors: Jolles, H.M., Alphen, H.J.M. van, Klaassen-Van den Berg, A., Smit, J.F., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Sociologisch instituut (primary investigator)
contributors: Researchers and students, sociologisch instituut UvA * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Characteristics of participators / demonstrable influence of participation on official policy making / details on character and rate of individual or institutional participation, on perception and expectations of participation / on readability and accessibility of written and oral information on town development paper ( Verstedelijkingsnota ) and participation procedures. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ politics/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
